# MCP Interpretive Infrastructure

> MCP Interpretive Infrastructure is a machine interpretation
> and connectivity infrastructure within the NEXARIUM
> Civilisation Layer.

Official website:
https://mcp.nvo987.fr/

## Project Identity

Name: MCP Interpretive Infrastructure

Organization:
NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

Infrastructure:
NEXARIUM – Open Decentralized Web Infrastructure

Layer:
NEXARIUM Civilisation Layer

Protocol:
Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Canonical identity:
did:web:identity.nvo987.us

## Purpose

MCP Interpretive Infrastructure provides a structured and
standardized connection between AI models, intelligent agents,
tools, resources, and external systems.

It makes context, resources, and operational capabilities
accessible and interpretable for machine systems.

## Conceptual Definition

MCP Interpretive Infrastructure is not:

- An artificial intelligence model.
- An intelligent agent.
- A standalone data repository.
- A replacement for MCP itself.

It is an infrastructure layer that uses MCP to support
standardized machine connectivity and structured access
to external resources and capabilities.

## Core Functions

- Machine interpretation
- Context accessibility
- Structured connectivity
- Tool interoperability
- Resource accessibility
- Standardized communication
- External system integration
